selection_policy.if_in_progress_exists: Continue the in_progress item unless the user redirects.
selection_policy.if_no_in_progress: Do not self-start the highest-priority not_started item. Start only from an explicit user request, maintainer-selected PR scope, or a clear issue/task mapping.
selection_policy.if_mapping_unclear: Ask for task selection or record the ambiguity before editing.

features.title: Add automatic historical backfill
features.user_visible_behavior: A new account can eventually mirror older messages beyond WINDOW_DAYS without manual intervention while fresh mail stays current.
features.notes: Backfill must be resumable, bounded, body-policy-aware, and safe around UIDVALIDITY resets and folder disappearance.

features.title: Build IMAP compatibility matrix and protocol validation
features.user_visible_behavior: Docs and tests make generic IMAP support explicit, provider-by-provider, with known quirks isolated in provider profiles.
verification: pnpm smoke:greenmail when protocol behavior changes
features.notes: Do not claim works with all IMAP. Frame support as generic IMAP core validated provider by provider.

features.title: Add MCP server for AI email tools
features.user_visible_behavior: A local stdio MCP server can safely expose read-oriented mailbox tools against an existing SupaMail database.
features.notes: Start local stdio first. Remote transport must be absent or explicitly bearer-token protected.
